summary: Adds a new integration subtest that starts a dynamic informer through the router, waits for sync, then creates and updates a resource and asserts the informer sees the add and update events. It only adds test coverage for watch behavior, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: New integration test: informer syncs and follows changes via router
reason: A new test-only subtest was added with no production code change, so it cannot affect runtime behavior.
